text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 14-person field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from roughly 25 minutes to under 10. That time went straight into more customer visits.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were more complete and consistent, so managers finally had reliable pipeline context.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated at first. A short, upfront ask fixed it.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what it meant. Reps still had to add the "so what."

**5. Adoption followed coaching.** Teams that reviewed transcripts in 1:1s used it far more.

Our takeaway: AI saves time, but people turn notes into insight.

What's your team learned from AI pilots?
